relations.rationale: Both describe separate helper actions but neither implies the other's occurrence or likelihood.
Driving a minibus has no bearing on greeting vendors.
Driving the minibus is unrelated to the smell of the morning air.
Driving the minibus does not indicate age status.
Driving the minibus doesn't directly relate to Nell's feelings of pride, though both are about Nell.
Isla being taller than Bo doesn't determine her height relative to Ben.
Height comparison has no bearing on helping set up chairs.
Isla's height relative to Bo is unrelated to customers examining produce.
Height comparison is unrelated to sales ranking.
Isla's height compared to Bo has no bearing on Ben restocking bread.
Isla's height relative to Ben doesn't affect her helping with chairs.
Height comparison is unrelated to Esme's arrival time.
Height comparison between Isla and Ben doesn't imply anything about team assignments.
Helping set up chairs doesn't indicate age seniority.
Isla helping with chairs is unrelated to Ben restocking bread.
Isla's help with chairs is a separate event from vendors thanking each other, no logical link.
Esme's early arrival could plausibly support her having time to greet vendors warmly.
Esme's arrival time is unrelated to Nell's feelings of pride.
Esme greeting vendors warmly is unrelated to customers examining baskets.
Ben and Bo being on different teams doesn't determine Bo and Isla's team relationship.
